newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius bourse index drifts lower on thin volume.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius bourse index drifts lower on thin volume.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius index, Semdex, drifted lower by 2.74 points to 367.66 on Friday amid thin volume transacted, brokers said.
Turnover was posted at 5.69 million rupees on 225,795 shares from 5.49 million rupees on 181,221 shares.
Brokers said foreign investors were still adopting a wait-and-see attitude.
"During the last four trading sessions the Semdex lost 12.02 points and investors see index falling as a wrong signal," one broker said.
"The Semdex downmoving trend will continue until 350.0 points," another broker said.
Brokers said falling shares on New Mauritius Hotel (NMH), Air Mauritius and Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) were the major stocks that brought market down.
NMH lost 90 cents to 37.00 rupees on 104,500 shares. Sun Resorts fell 70 cents to 45.30 rupees and Grand Baie Hotel was stable at 51.00 rupees, but both shares were not quoted.
Air Mauritius was 2.10 rupees lower to 33.20 on 3,329 shares. MCB eased 50 cents to 87.00 rupees on 6,775 shares and State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged at 12.00 rupees on 11,810 shares.

In the commerce sector, Ireland Blyth Ltd edged 70 cents to 15.70 rupees on 16,507 shares, Happy World Foods lost 10 cents to 14.50 rupees on 8,734 shares and Rogers remained to 91.00 rupees and was unquoted.

Investment stocks Fincorp fell 1.50 rupee to 65.00 rupees on 1,500 shares, National Investment Trust (NIT) eased 30 cents to 9.90 rupees on 4,300 shares and Promotion And Development rose 10 cents to 12.80 rupees on 3,665 shares.
Sugar based Mon Desert Alma O) lost 2.00 rupees to 73.00 on 300 shares.
